rule: The canonical v0.11.1 historical release is restored and reconciled. Before any successor implementation is admitted, each prospective v1 MUST capability must be compared against existing sealed evidence so already-satisfied capability is not rebuilt and only objective remaining gaps enter successor governance.

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: The v1 contract requires end-to-end governed specification, discovery, traceability, task compilation, prompt/context compilation, execution planning/resume and durable lifecycle evidence. Existing v0.11.1 evidence must be reconciled against that complete v1 scope before any missing capability is asserted.
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: High: may retire multiple prospective v1 requirements using already-preserved capability evidence and prevents duplicate implementation.
completion_evidence: claim-by-claim mapping from v1 MUST-01..06 to exact sealed v0.11.1 artifacts/tests

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Version 1.00 requires deterministic stale/change propagation and reproducible provenance semantics across promotion-authoritative artifacts. Existing v0.11.1 lifecycle/dependency/provenance evidence must be reconciled against the broader v1 freshness contract.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-07 and MUST-08 change propagation, determinism and provenance
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: High: freshness errors can invalidate otherwise-correct automation and release evidence.
completion_evidence: determinism/provenance evidence mapped to exact v1 claims

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Version 1.00 requires preregistered real-project transfer evidence for any v1 transfer/rework claims. Existing transfer protocols and trials must be reconciled against the final intended claims and denominators.
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: High: distinguishes self-dogfood/synthetic success from transferable user value.
completion_evidence: claim-limited reconciliation with uncertainty and limitations

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Version 1.00 requires clean package/install/extraction reproducibility, security/data integrity and active regression memory. v0.11.1 already contains substantial integrity evidence, but the exact v1 scope must be reconciled before remaining work is admitted.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-10 through MUST-12 packaging, security/data integrity and regression memory
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: High: existing sealed release evidence may satisfy much of this cluster while exposing any genuinely missing v1 hardening.
completion_evidence: package/install/clean-extraction evidence mapped to v1 scope
active regression ledger and retirement rules

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Version 1.00 requires documentation/examples matching behavior and a coherent supported CLI/API/workflow surface. Existing CLI and documentation evidence must be checked against the final v1 user contract.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-13 and MUST-14 documentation/examples and usability
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: Medium-high: identifies whether user-facing gaps are actual capability blockers or documentation-only work.

objective_v1_must_blockers.observed_gap: Final v1 independent verification, exact release lineage and shipping seal cannot complete until all substantive v1 MUST evidence has been reconciled and any true capability gaps are closed.
objective_v1_must_blockers.v1_capability_advanced: MUST-15 and MUST-16 independent verification and final release lineage
objective_v1_must_blockers.expected_information_value: Terminal gate: proves the exact v1 candidate rather than an earlier or stale state.
completion_evidence: zero unresolved substantive v1 MUST blockers
authoritative shipping manifest and clean extraction
completion receipt, release notes, version 1.0.0 and tag/release where tooling permits

convergence_review.question: What specifically prevents v1.00 right now?
convergence_review.answer: The restored v0.11.1 baseline no longer blocks progress. Six objective v1 evidence/capability clusters remain to reconcile. The immediate legal work is evidence reconciliation against the sealed baseline; successor implementation is admitted only for gaps that survive that review.
